idea: Little science wonder (BACKYARD): Jimmy and Ava have an empty flower pot and one tiny bean seed; Jimmy plants it, Ava asks the viewer 'What does the seed need?' (pause), they give it water (pink watering can) and sunshine, the babies stretch up tall as the sprout grows, and day by day it becomes a little yellow flower. Lesson: seeds need water and sun to grow.
title: Oh No! Empty Pot! 🌱 How Does a Seed Grow? | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh no! Baby Jimmy and Baby Ava have an empty flower pot and just one tiny seed! 🌱 They plant it, give it water and sunshine – and day by day it grows into a little yellow flower!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Oh no! Empty pot! Just a tiny seed!"
👆 Jimmy plants the seed – push, push, push!
🤔 Ava asks: "What does the seed need?" – can you answer?
💧 Water, water! ☀️ Sunshine, sunshine!
🙌 Grow, grow, little seed! Stretch up tall with Jimmy and Ava!
🌼 Day by day, a flower! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: seeds need water and sunshine to grow • English words: seed, water, sun, grow, flower

A fun little science song for toddlers and preschoolers about how a seed grows into a plant – sing along, answer the question and stretch up tall like a growing flower!
